rows.commentary: 3.5: Riley Meredith pushes the pace to 139kph and follows the shuffling Harry Brook, but the skipper whips his wrists to carve the full delivery cleanly along the turf through extra cover for four.
3.6: Riley Meredith delivers a 139.3kph low full toss that a backing-away Harry Brook simply taps toward cover for a single to retain the strike, capping a massive 24-run over.
4.1: Ben Dwarshuis is greeted instantly by the boundary rope as a reaching Harry Brook gets a fortunate under-edge on this 126kph shortish delivery outside off, guiding it fine of short third man.
4.2: Ben Dwarshuis angles this 119.7kph delivery away on a length, and Harry Brook attempts an off-side pat with an angled blade only to inside-edge it perilously past his leg-stump.
4.3: Ben Dwarshuis lands a 132kph delivery on a length just outside off, which Tom Banton dead-bats smoothly towards backward point.
4.4: Ben Dwarshuis clocks in at 118.4kph with a fuller ball outside off, forcing Harry Brook to throw his hands at it and inside-edge a hurried deflection down to backward square leg.

4.5: Ben Dwarshuis delivers a length ball that Tom Banton punches uppishly back, drawing a desperate one-handed reflex grab from the bowler that only manages fingertips before dropping away for a single.
4.6: Ben Dwarshuis drops it back of a length around off at 120.6kph, and Harry Brook stands tall to dismiss it with supreme disdain over deep midwicket for six.
5.1: Jack Edwards tests Tom Banton with a 126.8kph short-of-length delivery, but the batsman advances down the track to slap it straight to the fielder at mid-off.
5.2: Jack Edwards slips in an 115.1kph slower ball that raps Tom Banton high on the back thigh as he plays an early flick, earning a harmless leg bye.
5.3: Jack Edwards bowls a 114.6kph short delivery which Harry Brook meets with a blistering whippy pull, bringing up the fifty partnership by depositing it straight into the deep midwicket crowd.
5.4: Jack Edwards offers a tempting overpitched delivery that Harry Brook immediately gets underneath, blazing it straight of mid-off to race away for a boundary and seal a blistering 20-ball fifty.
5.5: Jack Edwards drops this slower delivery right into the blockhole, forcing Harry Brook to check his stroke and prod a single down to mid-on.

5.6: Jack Edwards offers pace off the length, and Tom Banton clears his front leg before launching a ferocious bottom-handed wipe high over Tim David at long-on to seal a staggering seventy-four-run powerplay.
6.1: Joel Davies darts a fullish delivery into the pads, allowing Harry Brook to tap it neatly away on the on-side for a single.
6.2: Joel Davies floats it up, and Tom Banton knocks it down to long-off for a single.
6.3: Joel Davies drifts into the slot, and Harry Brook sweeps it away into the deep mid-wicket pocket to scamper back for two brisk runs.
17.3: Adam Zampa fires it wide to counter the charge, but Jordan Cox adjusts brilliantly to club it over cover for a one-bounce boundary.
17.4: Adam Zampa delivers a straightforward ball punched firmly down toward long-on for a single.
17.5: Adam Zampa cramps Liam Dawson for room on the back foot, watching the inside edge ricochet off pad and keeper alike.
17.6: Jordan Cox skips down and drives straight into his partner's front pad, saving a boundary in a painful collision.
18.1: Riley Meredith watches Liam Dawson manoeuvre inside the line to cue-end a scoop toward the on-side.
18.2: Jordan Cox anticipates the length and executes an audacious reverse-hit past short third man for four.
18.3: Riley Meredith deploys a clever slower cutter to completely deceive the batter attempting another reverse shot.
18.4: Riley Meredith strikes as Jordan Cox skies a hard-length delivery straight to Joel Davies waiting at mid-wicket.
18.5: Riley Meredith cuts Jamie Overton entirely in half with a sharp angle missing the leg-stump by a coat of paint.
18.6: Riley Meredith targets the body with heat as Jamie Overton top-edges a frantic pull into safe no-man's-land.
19.1: Jack Edwards drops pace on a short delivery outside off, allowing Jamie Overton to drag it toward the on-side.
19.2: Liam Dawson swings hard at a low full toss outside off and launches it flat toward long-on, where Tim David sprints and dives full length only for the ball to slip through his grasping fingers.
19.3: Jack Edwards drives it very full and on the off-stump, allowing Liam Dawson to dig it out toward long-off for a single.
19.4: Jack Edwards delivers a masterclass of fast bowling, breaching Jamie Overton's defenses to rattle the woodwork and end his brief stay at the crease.
6.1: Will Jacks drops it on middle and leg, and Mitchell Marsh sinks low to slog sweep it over Phil Salt's head at deep square leg for four.
6.2: Will Jacks offers a delivery that Mitchell Marsh drills hard down to long-off for a single.
6.3: Will Jacks floats one up on middle and leg, allowing Nikhil Chaudhary to knock it cleanly to long-on.
6.4: Will Jacks attacks the middle and leg line again as Mitchell Marsh sweeps straight to deep square leg for a single.
6.5: Will Jacks beats the bat as Nikhil Chaudhary attempts a reverse sweep, finding only backward point.
6.6: Will Jacks watches Nikhil Chaudhary unleash another reverse sweep wide of point, racing back for a brace as sweeper cover mops it up.
7.1: Adil Rashid offers a hint of width outside off, and Mitchell Marsh slashes it through point to collect a single.
7.2: Adil Rashid slows the pace right down on a fuller length, inducing Nikhil Chaudhary to knock it defensively toward cover.
7.3: Adil Rashid fires it full and straight outside off, where Nikhil Chaudhary plays late to short third man and is rightfully sent back by Marsh.
7.4: Adil Rashid drops it shorter around middle, and Nikhil Chaudhary swipes it through mid-wicket, refusing a risky second run.
7.5: Adil Rashid keeps it fractionally short outside off, prompting Mitchell Marsh to rock back and punch it out to sweeper cover.
7.6: Adil Rashid tosses it invitingly around middle, deftly clipped to mid-wicket for a single as a wily over yields just four runs.
8.1: Liam Dawson feeds it full on the leg-stump line, and Nikhil Chaudhary drops to one knee to sweep it securely away to the fine leg fence.
8.2: Liam Dawson errs with room as Nikhil Chaudhary clears the cover infield with exquisite timing.
8.3: Liam Dawson watches Nikhil Chaudhary flick it to deep mid-wicket before a sharp fielding effort restricts them to a single.
8.4: Liam Dawson fires it full and straight into the stumps, inducing a simple defensive push into the off-side from Mitchell Marsh.
8.5: Liam Dawson drops one slightly short outside off, allowing Mitchell Marsh to rock back and carve a single through the off-side.
8.6: Liam Dawson loops it up around middle and leg, where Nikhil Chaudhary uses soft hands to clip it through the leg-side for a pair.
